name: ANTONIO (ANTONIUS) SACCO
bioAdditions: Antonio married Anna Villella on 7 May 1746; the index notes that the groom came from Pittarella (S1), a hamlet of Pedivigliano in the Savuto valley. A San Mango baptism of an Antonio Sacco on 26 January 1729 exists, but it names his parents as Gioacchino Sacco and Mattea Pagliuso, not the tree's Carmine Sacco (S2). Because the groom was from Pittarella, that baptism may belong to a different Antonio.

conflicts.foundValue: San Mango 1729 baptism of an Antonius Sacco names Joachim Sacco and Matthea Pagliuso; the groom of 1746 was from Pittarella
conflicts.assessment: Unresolved: either the tree's Carmine comes from Pittarella records, or the 1729 San Mango baptism is his and the father is Gioacchino.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Marriage confirmed; birth and parentage conflict.
